objectives.en: Explain the scope of e-business: B2B, B2C, intra-B and C2C

narration.en: At midnight you can order a book, book a bus ticket and pay your electricity bill from your phone. Business has moved onto the internet.
narration.kn: ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಫೋನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಬಸ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದಿರಿಸಬಹುದು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಬಿಲ್ ಪಾವತಿಸಬಹುದು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಸಾಗಿದೆ.

body.en: E-business is the conduct of industry, trade and commerce using computer networks. E-commerce, the buying and selling part, is only a subset of it. Its scope covers B2B transactions between firms, B2C transactions between firms and customers, intra-B transactions within a firm, and C2C transactions between consumers.

narration.kn: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನಡೆಸುವುದೇ ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ. ಇ-ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಅದರ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ. ಬಿ2ಬಿ, ಬಿ2ಸಿ, ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿ2ಸಿ ಇದರ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ.

title.en: On the board: E-business and its scope

narration.en: E-business is the whole of business done over computer networks. E-commerce, buying and selling online, is only a part of it.

say.en: E-business is the whole of business done over computer networks. E-commerce, buying and selling online, is only a part of it.
Remember: all e-commerce is e-business, but not all e-business is e-commerce.
Its scope has four kinds of transactions.
Intra-B is within one firm; C2C is between consumers, such as reselling a used bicycle online.
How does e-business differ from traditional business?
But e-business has less personal touch, no physical sampling and higher transaction risk.

explanation.en: B2B: firm to firm; B2C: firm to customer (both ways); C2C: consumer to consumer; intra-B: within one firm.

text.en: A car maker orders tyres from its supplier online
A kirana shop restocks from a wholesaler's app
You buy a phone on a shopping website
A bank sends you an EMI reminder by SMS
Selling your old cycle to another student on a classifieds site
Two buyers bid for a used phone on an auction site
The sales team updates the factory through the company intranet
Employees apply for leave on the HR portal

body.en: An e-business is easier and cheaper to form, needs no physical presence, and its location hardly matters. It has direct contact with suppliers and customers, faster internal communication, shorter business cycles and easy access to global markets. However, it offers less personal touch, no physical sampling of products, and higher transaction risk.

points.en: Less personal touch; higher transaction risk
